column1: # Transport networks (plan step 9). network <tab> extra ticks <tab> requirement for every ride <tab> what belongs in it.
# A transport belongs to a network through its "network" field. Every ride then needs the network's requirement as well
# as its own, and costs its own ride time (from the Wiki or Shortest Path) plus the network's extra ticks (owner
# 2026-10-12: "both"; change the extras here or in the Data Tool, Route tab, "Teleport and travel costs ...").
# "Network stop" transports (any stop to any other) are used for networks where every stop reaches every other;
# the others are ordinary one-way / two-way rides with the network set.
